subject: what to fund in cycle 1

attempts.text: @Priority Four workflows cover the full charter scope for 60 against a 50 budget; rate-card minimum is 60 because hours and location share one section part. Cheapest cut if Priority must: none keeps done-when intact, so I ask for a counter rather than dropping the gallery or farms. Order: W1, W2, then W3 and W4.

@Adaptation COUNTER: all four workflows stay, total 50 against a 50 budget. Two cuts of 5 each: (1) drop the separate styling part from W1, since the baseline CSS and the breakpoints come with the page sections; (2) cost W2 as one interactive_feature, because a browser-only order builder with no submit or backend is not a form. If you think W2 is a true form, say why, and the fallback is to park W4 (farms) until budget frees up. Trade-off: zero reserve, so retry_limit is 0 and there is no money for a fix (8). Nothing may exceed its envelope.
attempts.position: COUNTER: Page shell, nav, menu, hours and location (20), Pickup pre-order builder (10), Large photo gallery (10), Three farm stories (10)

attempts.text: @Priority ACCEPT at 50 of 50. W2 is a browser-only order builder with no submit, so one interactive_feature is a fair cost, and baseline CSS and breakpoints ship inside W1's sections. Risk accepted: no reserve and retry_limit 0, so any failed check means parking that item, not fixing it. Order: W1, then W2, W3, W4.

outcome: Adaptation accepted Priority's COUNTER: Page shell, nav, menu, hours and location (20), Pickup pre-order builder (10), Large photo gallery (10), Three farm stories (10) goes to the validator.

priority_final.name: Page shell, nav, menu, hours and location
priority_final.goal_gap: No page exists: no nav, menu, hours or location sections.
priority_final.expected_outcome: Single HTML file with viewport meta, responsive CSS breakpoints, anchor nav, a menu section with categories and placeholder prices, and hours and location sections (separate anchors) with marked placeholders and a directions link placeholder.
priority_final.completion_check: File has viewport meta, at least one @media breakpoint, nav links to #menu #hours #location #preorder #gallery #farms, menu with at least 2 categories, hours and location sections present, every unknown value visibly marked as placeholder.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the file lacks viewport meta or any #menu, #hours or #location anchor after the first pass, or if calls exceed 3.

priority_final.name: Pickup pre-order builder
priority_final.goal_gap: Visitors cannot build an order or get a summary to send.
priority_final.expected_outcome: Browser-only pre-order section: pick items and quantities from the menu, choose pickup time, see running total or item list, and generate an order summary for a send channel placeholder (WhatsApp or email).
priority_final.completion_check: Item quantities update a visible total or list, a pickup time field exists, a Generate summary button produces text containing items, quantities and pickup time, and send channel and time rules are marked placeholders.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the summary does not contain items, quantities and pickup time after the first pass, or if calls exceed 2.

priority_final.name: Large photo gallery
priority_final.expected_outcome: Responsive gallery grid with 12 image slots, each with alt text, loading=lazy and a visible Photo placeholder label.
priority_final.completion_check: Count of gallery img or slot elements is at least 12; each has non-empty alt and loading=lazy; each is visibly marked as placeholder.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if fewer than 12 slots or any slot lacks alt text or loading=lazy after the first pass.

priority_final.name: Three farm stories
priority_final.expected_outcome: Three separate farm entries, each with name, location, story text and photo slot, all as marked placeholders until facts are supplied.
priority_final.completion_check: Exactly 3 farm entries, each containing name, location, story and photo slot elements; all values visibly marked placeholder; no invented farm facts.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if there are not exactly 3 entries, or any farm fact appears that is not a marked placeholder.
